verification.scope: Section-level source navigation and precise, qualified reading notes across the eight core Sounds of Odisha stories.
verification.tests: 534 full-site tests, 192 coastal tests and 1572 page acceptance checks pass. Publication/search/launch audits retain 11 indexable routes. Initial test exposed an assertion escaping apostrophes differently in HTML attributes; corrected normalization, then all 192 passed. Registration readiness corrected from unsupported implementation to draft before review.
verification.visual: 390x844 Huluhuli and 1280x900 Daskathia inspected. Keyboard Enter opens the source disclosure and focuses the exact numbered note; no horizontal overflow. Visible target outline and wrapped source limitations inspected.
verification.factual_scope: Existing eight source dossiers searched and read before mapping. Stable source identifiers and original access limitations reused. Precise page/section locators checked against saved evidence; no new external retrieval, listening, human review or fieldwork claimed.
verification.diff_review: Only block source_ids and source locator fields added to the eight canonical narratives; original fields remain unchanged. Narrative hashes checked. All 55 links map to valid numbered notes. Pure editorial passages are left without factual citations. Artwork, tongue-motion correction, reading paths and indexing limits retained.

limitations: Same-assistant review; not an independent human, language or practitioner review.
Source access varies: indexed-only records, unavailable page images and unplayed media remain explicitly qualified in their notes.
This maps previously recorded evidence; it does not refresh source availability or establish disputed origins.
